basics.name: Anh-Minh Hoang (Eric)
basics.summary: AI alignment research focused on model representations, self-critique, and reliable safeguards for increasingly capable language models.

publications.title: Latent-Target Poisoning: Discovering Attack Populations in Coding Assistants
publications.status: ACL ARR, October 2026 cycle · Under review
bullets: Discovered target populations from frozen model representations and poisoned training responses to induce unwanted code on unchanged requests.
Compared four population selectors across two model families and two datasets, measuring target emission, spillover, and coding functionality.

publications.title: SafePrompt: Jailbreak Search Defense through Activation Signatures
publications.status: ACL ARR, October 2026 cycle · Under review
bullets: Developed an activation-based filter for jailbreak search that passes accepted requests unchanged to a separate language model.
Across two models, reduced PAIR attack success from 91–92% to 14–17% at 90 queries per goal, rejecting 2.53% of 750 legitimate requests; evaluated adaptive search and sensitive-topic utility.

publications.title: CSR: Physically conditioned scale-transfer super-resolution across optical missions
publications.authors: Minh A. Hoang and Nidal Kamel
publications.status: Under review at ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
bullets: Developed satellite image reconstruction using wavelength and pixel-size information to transfer across sensors.
Achieved the largest mean structural improvement on all four 4× OpenSR benchmark suites; evaluated transfer on 174 held-out PROBA-V scenes.
Built satellite-image training and evaluation pipelines in PyTorch Lightning and Hydra for Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9, NAIP, and VENµS, using data accessed through Planetary Computer STAC.

awards.text: Regional winner, RMIT AI Hackathon; highest AU-ROC model among 400+ teams.
Top 13 among 100+ university teams, 1st Vietnamese National Collegiate AI Olympiad (OLPAI).

skills.Research: Alignment, model representations, safety evaluation, training-data poisoning, KL-regularized adaptation.
skills.Tools: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, LoRA/PEFT, vLLM, verl, PyTorch Lightning, Hydra.

current_research.title: Constitutional self-alignment
bullets: Investigating whether self-critique and on-policy distillation can improve adherence to explicit principles with minimal supervised or RLHF intervention.
